page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 104 dedicated virtual central processing units alongside 192.0 GB of system memory. This hardware allocation yields a compute-dense ratio of approximately 1.85 GB of memory per core.

The server does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators, requiring external network-attached volumes for persistent data storage. Networking performance is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating sustained network communication between distributed nodes and external storage tiers.

Architecturally, the resource profile emphasizes high concurrent CPU throughput over per-thread memory capacity. Because all storage must be provisioned externally over the network, storage latency relies directly on network disk configuration. This balance makes the instance appropriate for CPU-bound tasks such as parallel batch processing, continuous integration build clusters, scientific computing, and high-concurrency web serving fleets.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.26xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The instance includes 32 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and contains no integrated local storage or dedicated graphics processing units, requiring external network-attached volumes for persistent data needs. With its compute-heavy resource density, this server delivers substantial multi-threaded processing capacity while maintaining a lean memory footprint. The configuration represents an efficient architecture for highly parallelized tasks that do not require massive per-thread memory allocations. Typical workload fits include large-scale batch processing, distributed build environments, video transcoding pipelines, computational modeling, and dense front-end web server deployments.
